verses.text_uthmani: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ

trs.20: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
trs.85: Ever closer to people draws their reckoning, while they turn away, heedless.
trs.22: Closer and closer to mankind comes their Reckoning: yet they heed not and they turn away.
trs.203: Draws near for mankind their reckoning, while they turn away in heedlessness.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ

trs.20: No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
trs.85: Whenever any fresh revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it playfully
trs.22: Never comes (aught) to them of a renewed Message from their Lord, but they listen to it as in jest,-
trs.203: Comes not unto them an admonition (a chapter of the Qur’ân) from their Lord as a recent revelation but they listen to it while they play

verses.text_uthmani: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ

trs.20: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
trs.85: with frivolous hearts. The evildoers conferred in secret: ‘Is this man anything but a mortal like yourselves? Are you going to fall under his spell with your eyes wide open?’
trs.22: Their hearts toying as with trifles. The wrong-doers conceal their private counsels, (saying), "Is this (one) more than a man like yourselves? Will ye go to witchcraft with your eyes open?"
trs.203: With their hearts occupied (with evil things). Those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels, (saying): "Is this (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) more than a human being like you? Will you submit to magic while you see it?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

trs.20: He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
trs.85: He said, ‘My Lord knows everything that is said in the heavens and the earth: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.’
trs.22: Say: "My Lord knoweth (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth: He is the One that heareth and knoweth (all things)."
trs.203: He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: "My Lord knows (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower."

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ

trs.20: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
trs.85: Some say, ‘Muddled dreams’; others, ‘He made it up’; yet others, ‘He is just a poet, let him show us a sign as previous messengers did.’
trs.22: "Nay," they say, "(these are) medleys of dream! - Nay, He forged it! - Nay, He is (but) a poet! Let him then bring us a Sign like the ones that were sent to (Prophets) of old!"
trs.203: Nay, they say: "These (revelations of the Qur’ân which are revealed to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented them! - Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Ayâh (sign as a proof) like the ones (Prophets) the former were sent (with)!"

verses.text_uthmani: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them,<sup foot_note=196781>1</sup> so will they believe?
trs.85: But of the communities We destroyed before them not a single one believed. Will these now believe?
trs.22: (As to those) before them, not one of the populations which We destroyed believed: will these believe?
trs.203: Not one of the towns (populations), of those which We destroyed, believed before them (though We sent them signs): will they then believe?

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ

trs.20: And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
trs.85: And even before your time [Prophet], all the messengers We sent were only men We inspired–– if you [disbelievers] do not know, ask people who know the Scripture––
trs.22: Before thee, also, the messengers We sent were but men, to whom We granted inspiration: If ye realise this not, ask of those who possess the Message.
trs.203: And We sent not before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) but men to whom We revealed. So ask the people of the Reminder [Scriptures - the Taurât (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel)] if you do not know.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ

trs.20: And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food,<sup foot_note=196782>1</sup> nor were they immortal [on earth].
trs.85: We did not give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.
trs.22: Nor did We give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they exempt from death.
trs.203: And We did not create them (the Messengers, with) bodies that ate not food, nor were they immortals.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

trs.20: Then<sup foot_note=196783>1</sup> We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
trs.85: We fulfilled Our promise to them in the end: We saved them and those We wished to save, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
trs.22: In the end We fulfilled to them Our Promise, and We saved them and those whom We pleased, but We destroyed those who transgressed beyond bounds.
trs.203: Then We fulfilled to them the promise. So We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifûn (i.e. disbelievers in Allah, in His Messengers, extravagants, transgressors of Allâh’s limits by committing crimes, oppressions, polytheism and sins).

verses.text_uthmani: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

trs.20: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention.<sup foot_note=196784>1</sup> Then will you not reason?
trs.85: And now We have sent down to you [people] a Scripture to remind you. Will you not use your reason?
trs.22: We have revealed for you (O men!) a book in which is a Message for you: will ye not then understand?
trs.203: Indeed, We have sent down for you (O mankind) a Book (the Qur’ân) in which there is Dhikrukum,(your Reminder or an honour for you i.e. honour for the one who follows the teaching of the Qur’ân and acts on its teachings). Will you not then understand?

verses.text_uthmani: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

trs.20: And how many a city which was unjust<sup foot_note=196785>1</sup> have We shattered and produced after it another people.
trs.85: How many communities of evildoers We have destroyed! How many others We have raised up in their places!
trs.22: How many were the populations We utterly destroyed because of their iniquities, setting up in their places other peoples?
trs.203: How many a town (community) given to wrong-doing, have We destroyed, and raised up after them another people!

verses.text_uthmani: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ

trs.20: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
trs.85: When they felt Our might coming upon them, see how they tried to escape it!
trs.22: Yet, when they felt Our Punishment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.
trs.203: Then, when they perceived (saw) Our Torment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ

trs.20: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."<sup foot_note=196786>1</sup>
trs.85: ‘Do not try to escape. Go back to your homes and the pleasure you revelled in: you may be questioned.’
trs.22: Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account.
trs.203: Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
trs.85: They said, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
trs.22: They said: "Ah! woe to us! We were indeed wrong-doers!"
trs.203: They cried: "Woe to us! Certainly we have been Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)."

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ

trs.20: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
trs.85: and that cry of theirs did not cease until We made them burnt-offstubble.
trs.22: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is mown, as ashes silent and quenched.
trs.203: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is reaped, extinct (dead).

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ

trs.20: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
trs.85: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them playfully.
trs.22: Not for (idle) sport did We create the heavens and the earth and all that is between!
trs.203: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them for a (mere) play.<sup foot_note=154720>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ

trs.20: Had We intended to take a diversion,<sup foot_note=196787>1</sup> We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
trs.85: If We had wished for a pastime, We could have found it within Us- if We had wished for any such thing.
trs.22: If it had been Our wish to take (just) a pastime, We should surely have taken it from the things nearest to Us, if We would do (such a thing)!
trs.203: Had We intended to take a pastime (i.e. a wife or a son), We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were going to do (that).

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ

trs.20: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it,<sup foot_note=196789>1</sup> and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.<sup foot_note=196788>2</sup>
trs.85: No! We hurl the truth against falsehood, and truth obliterates it- see how falsehood vanishes away! Woe to you [people] for the way you describe God!
trs.22: Nay, We hurl the Truth against falsehood, and it knocks out its brain, and behold, falsehood doth perish! Ah! woe be to you for the (false) things ye ascribe (to Us).
trs.203: Nay, We fling (send down) the truth (this Qur’ân) against the falsehood (disbelief), so it destroys it, and behold, it (falsehood) is vanished. And woe to you for that (lie) which you ascribe (to Allâh by uttering that Allâh has a wife and a son).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ

trs.20: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
trs.85: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and those that are with Him are never too proud to worship Him, nor do they grow weary;
trs.22: To Him belong all (creatures) in the heavens and on earth: Even those who are in His (very) Presence are not too proud to serve Him, nor are they (ever) weary (of His service):
trs.203: To Him belongs whosoever is in the heavens and on earth. And those who are near Him (i.e. the angels) are not too proud to worship Him, nor are they weary (of His worship).

verses.text_uthmani: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ

trs.20: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
trs.85: they glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
trs.22: They celebrate His praises night and day, nor do they ever flag or intermit.
trs.203: They (i.e. the angels) glorify His Praises night and day, (and) they never slacken (to do so).

verses.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ

trs.20: Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
trs.85: Have they chosen any gods from the earth who can give life to the dead?
trs.22: Or have they taken (for worship) gods from the earth who can raise (the dead)?
trs.203: Or have they taken (for worship) âlihah (gods) from the earth who raise the dead?

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ

trs.20: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
trs.85: If there had been in the heavens or earth any gods but Him, both heavens and earth would be in ruins: God, Lord of the Throne, is far above the things they say:
trs.22: If there were, in the heavens and the earth, other gods besides Allah, there would have been confusion in both! but glory to Allah, the Lord of the Throne: (High is He) above what they attribute to Him!
trs.203: Had there been therein (in the heavens and the earth) âlihah (gods) besides Allâh, then verily both would have been ruined. Glorified be Allâh, the Lord of the Throne, (High is He) above all that (evil) they associate with Him!

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ

trs.20: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
trs.85: He cannot be called to account for anything He does, whereas they will be called to account.
trs.22: He cannot be questioned for His acts, but they will be questioned (for theirs).
trs.203: He cannot be questioned as to what He does, while they will be questioned.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ

trs.20: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me."<sup foot_note=196790>1</sup> But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
trs.85: Have they chosen to worship other gods instead of Him? Say, ‘Bring your proof. This is the Scripture for those who are with me and the Scripture for those who went before me.’ But most of them do not recognize the truth, so they pay no heed.
trs.22: Or have they taken for worship (other) gods besides him? Say, "Bring your convincing proof: this is the Message of those with me and the Message of those before me." But most of them know not the Truth, and so turn away.
trs.203: Or have they taken for worship (other) âlihah (gods) besides Him? Say: "Bring your proof." This (the Qur’ân) is the Reminder for those with me and the Reminder for those before me. But most of them know not the Truth, so they are averse.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ

trs.20: And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
trs.85: We never sent any messenger before you [Muhammad] without revealing to him: ‘There is no god but Me, so serve Me.’
trs.22: Not a messenger did We send before thee without this inspiration sent by Us to him: that there is no god but I; therefore worship and serve Me.
trs.203: And We did not send any Messenger before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) but We revealed to him (saying): Lâ ilâha illa Ana [none has the right to be worshipped but I (Allâh)], so worship Me (Alone and none else)."

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ

trs.20: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they<sup foot_note=196791>1</sup> are [but] honored servants.
trs.85: And they say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has taken offspring for Himself.’ May He be exalted! No! They are only His honoured servants:
trs.22: And they say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten offspring." Glory to Him! they are (but) servants raised to honour.
trs.203: And they say: "The Most Gracious (Allâh) has begotten a son (or children)." Glory to Him! They [whom they call children of Allâh i.e. the angels, ‘Îsâ (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary), ‘Uzair (Ezra)], are but honoured slaves.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ

trs.20: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
trs.85: they do not speak before He speaks and they act by His command.
trs.22: They speak not before He speaks, and they act (in all things) by His Command.
trs.203: They speak not until He has spoken, and they act on His Command.

verses.text_uthmani: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ

trs.20: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them,<sup foot_note=196792>1</sup> and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
trs.85: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede without His permission––indeed they themselves stand in awe of Him.
trs.22: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they offer no intercession except for those who are acceptable, and they stand in awe and reverence of His (Glory).
trs.203: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him with whom He is pleased. And they stand in awe for fear of Him.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
trs.85: If any of them were to claim, ‘I am a god beside Him,’ We would reward them with Hell: this is how We reward evildoers.
trs.22: If any of them should say, "I am a god besides Him", such a one We should reward with Hell: thus do We reward those who do wrong.
trs.203: And if any of them should say: "Verily, I am an ilâh (a god) besides Him (Allâh)," such a one We should recompense with Hell. Thus We recompense the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).

verses.text_uthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ

trs.20: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
trs.85: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and the earth used to be joined together and that We ripped them apart, that We made every living thing from water? Will they not believe?
trs.22: Do not the Unbelievers see that the heavens and the earth were joined together (as one unit of creation), before we clove them asunder? We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
trs.203: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were joined together as one united piece, then We parted them? And We have made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ

trs.20: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
trs.85: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it should sway under them, and set broad paths on it, so that they might follow the right direction,
trs.22: And We have set on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein broad highways (between mountains) for them to pass through: that they may receive Guidance.
trs.203: And We have placed on the earth firm mountains, lest it should shake with them, and We placed therein broad highways for them to pass through, that they may be guided.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ

trs.20: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs,<sup foot_note=196793>1</sup> are turning away.
trs.85: and We made the sky a well-secured canopy- yet from its wonders they turn away.
trs.22: And We have made the heavens as a canopy well guarded: yet do they turn away from the Signs which these things (point to)!
trs.203: And We have made the heaven a roof, safe and well guarded. Yet they turn away from its signs (i.e. sun, moon, winds, clouds, etc.).

verses.text_uthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ

trs.20: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
trs.85: It is He who created night and day, the sun and the moon, each floating in its orbit.
trs.22: It is He Who created the Night and the Day, and the sun and the moon: all (the celestial bodies) swim along, each in its rounded course.
trs.203: And He it is Who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each in an orbit floating.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ

trs.20: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
trs.85: We have not granted everlasting life to any other human being before you either [Muhammad]- if you die, will [the disbelievers] live for ever?
trs.22: We granted not to any man before thee permanent life (here): if then thou shouldst die, would they live permanently?
trs.203: And We granted not to any human being immortality before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): then if you die, would they live forever?

verses.text_uthmani: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ

trs.20: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
trs.85: Every soul is certain to taste death: We test you all through the bad and the good, and to Us you will all return.
trs.22: Every soul shall have a taste of death: and We test you by evil and by good by way of trial. to Us must ye return.
trs.203: Everyone is going to taste death, and We shall make a trial of you with evil and with good. And to Us you will be returned.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ

trs.20: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
trs.85: When the disbelievers see you, they laugh at you: ‘Is this the one who talks about your gods?’ They reject any talk of the Lord of Mercy.
trs.22: When the Unbelievers see thee, they treat thee not except with ridicule. "Is this," (they say), "the one who talks of your gods?" and they blaspheme at the mention of (Allah) Most Gracious!
trs.203: And when those who disbelieved (in the Oneness of Allâh) see you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), they take you not except for mockery (saying): "Is this the one who talks (badly) about your gods?" While they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Gracious (Allâh). [Tafsir Al-Qurtubî].

verses.text_uthmani: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

trs.20: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.
trs.85: Man was created hasty: I will show you My signs soon, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
trs.22: Man is a creature of haste: soon (enough) will I show you My Signs; then ye will not ask Me to hasten them!
trs.203: Man is created of haste. I will show you My Ayât (torments, proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.). So ask Me not to hasten (them).

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ

trs.20: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
trs.85: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
trs.22: They say: "When will this promise come to pass, if ye are telling the truth?"
trs.203: And they say: "When will this promise (come to pass), if you are truthful."

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

trs.20: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...<sup foot_note=196794>1</sup>
trs.85: If the disbelievers only knew, the time will arrive when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces or their backs, and they will get no help.
trs.22: If only the Unbelievers knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the fire from their faces, nor yet from their backs, and (when) no help can reach them!
trs.203: If only those who disbelieved knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs, and they will not be helped.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ

trs.20: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
trs.85: It will come upon them suddenly and stupefy them; they will be powerless to push it away; they will not be reprieved.
trs.22: Nay, it may come to them all of a sudden and confound them: no power will they have then to avert it, nor will they (then) get respite.
trs.203: Nay, it (the Fire or the Day of Resurrection) will come upon them all of a sudden and will perplex them, and they will have no power to avert it nor will they get respite.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

trs.20: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
trs.85: Messengers before you [Muhammad] were also ridiculed, but those who mocked them were overwhelmed in the end by the very thing they had mocked.
trs.22: Mocked were (many) messenger before thee; But their scoffers were hemmed in by the thing that they mocked.
trs.203: Indeed, (many) Messengers were mocked before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), but the scoffers were surrounded by that, whereat they used to mock.

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ

trs.20: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
trs.85: Say, ‘Who could protect you night and day from the Lord of Mercy?’ Yet they turn away when their Lord is mentioned.
trs.22: Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord.
trs.203: Say: "Who can guard and protect you in the night or in the day from the (punishment of the) Most Gracious (Allâh)?" Nay, but they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord.

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ

trs.20: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
trs.85: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? Their gods have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
trs.22: Or have they gods that can guard them from Us? They have no power to aid themselves, nor can they be defended from Us.
trs.203: Or have they âlihah (gods) who can guard them from Us? They have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us (i.e. from Our Torment).

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ

trs.20: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders?<sup foot_note=196795>1</sup> Is it they who will overcome?
trs.85: We have allowed these sinners and their forefathers to enjoy life for a long time. But do they not see how We are shrinking their borders? Is it they who will prevail?
trs.22: Nay, We gave the good things of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them; See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will win?
trs.203: Nay, We gave the luxuries of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them. See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will overcome?<sup foot_note=154721>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ

trs.20: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
trs.85: Say, ‘I warn you only through the Revelation.’ The deaf will not hear the warning call,
trs.22: Say, "I do but warn you according to revelation": But the deaf will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned!
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I warn you only by the revelation (from Allâh and not by the opinion of the religious scholars and others). But the deaf (who follow the religious scholars and others blindly) will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned [i.e. one should follow only the Qur’ân and the Sunnah (legal ways, orders, acts of worship, and the statements of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, as the companions of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم did)]<sup foot_note=154722>1</sup>.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
trs.85: yet if a mere breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they will be sure to cry, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
trs.22: If but a breath of the Wrath of thy Lord do touch them, they will then say, "Woe to us! we did wrong indeed!"
trs.203: And if a breath (minor calamity) of the Torment of your Lord touches them, they will surely cry: "Woe unto us! Indeed we have been Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ

trs.20: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed,<sup foot_note=196796>1</sup> We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
trs.85: We will set up scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that no one can be wronged in the least, and if there should be even the weight of a mustard seed, We shall bring it out- We take excellent account.
trs.22: We shall set up scales of justice for the Day of Judgment, so that not a soul will be dealt with unjustly in the least, and if there be (no more than) the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account): and enough are We to take account.
trs.203: And We shall set up balances of justice on the Day of Resurrection, then none will be dealt with unjustly in anything. And if there be the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it. And Sufficient are We to take account.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ

trs.20: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder<sup foot_note=196797>1</sup> for the righteous
trs.85: We gave Moses and Aaron [the Scripture] that distinguishes right from wrong, a light and a reminder for those who are mindful of God,
trs.22: In the past We granted to Moses and Aaron the criterion (for judgment), and a Light and a Message for those who would do right,-
trs.203: And indeed We granted to Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron) the criterion (of right and wrong), and a shining light [i.e. the Taurât (Torah)] and a Reminder for Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).

verses.text_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ

trs.20: Who fear their Lord unseen,<sup foot_note=196798>1</sup> while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
trs.85: those who stand in awe of their Lord, though He is unseen, and who fear the Hour.
trs.22: Those who fear their Lord in their most secret thoughts, and who hold the Hour (of Judgment) in awe.
trs.203: Those who fear their Lord without seeing Him, and they are afraid of the Hour.

verses.text_uthmani: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ

trs.20: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?<sup foot_note=196799>1</sup>
trs.85: This [Quran] too is a blessed message We have sent down- are you [people] going to deny it?
trs.22: And this is a blessed Message which We have sent down: will ye then reject it?
trs.203: And this is a blessed Reminder (the Qur’ân) which We have sent down: will you then (dare to) deny it?<sup foot_note=154723>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before,<sup foot_note=196800>1</sup> and We were of him well-Knowing
trs.85: Long ago We bestowed right judgement on Abraham and We knew him well.
trs.22: We bestowed aforetime on Abraham his rectitude of conduct, and well were We acquainted with him.
trs.203: And indeed We bestowed aforetime on Ibrâhîm (Abraham) his (portion of) guidance, and We were Well-Acquainted with him (as to his Belief in the Oneness of Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ

trs.20: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
trs.85: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images to which you are so devoted?’
trs.22: Behold! he said to his father and his people, "What are these images, to which ye are (so assiduously) devoted?"
trs.203: When he said to his father and his people: "What are these images, to which you are devoted?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ

trs.20: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
trs.85: They replied, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them.’
trs.22: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them."
trs.203: They said: "We found our fathers worshipping them."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

trs.20: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
trs.85: He said, ‘You and your fathers have clearly gone astray.’
trs.22: He said, "Indeed ye have been in manifest error - ye and your fathers."
trs.203: He said: "Indeed, you and your fathers have been in manifest error."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ

trs.20: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
trs.85: They asked, ‘Have you brought us the truth or are you just playing about?’
trs.22: They said, "Have you brought us the Truth, or are you one of those who jest?"
trs.203: They said: "Have you brought us the truth, or are you one of those who play about?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ

trs.20: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
trs.85: He said, ‘Listen! Your true Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He who created them, and I am a witness to this.
trs.22: He said, "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He Who created them (from nothing): and I am a witness to this (Truth).
trs.203: He said: "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them and to that I am one of the witnesses.

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ

trs.20: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
trs.85: By God I shall certainly plot against your idols as soon as you have turned your backs!’
trs.22: "And by Allah, I have a plan for your idols - after ye go away and turn your backs"..
trs.203: "And by Allâh, I shall plot a plan (to destroy) your idols after you have gone away and turned your backs."

verses.text_uthmani: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ

trs.20: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
trs.85: He broke them all into pieces, but left the biggest one for them to return to.
trs.22: So he broke them to pieces, (all) but the biggest of them, that they might turn (and address themselves) to it.
trs.203: So he broke them to pieces, (all) except the biggest of them, that they might turn to it.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
trs.85: They said, ‘Who has done this to our gods? How wicked he must be!’
trs.22: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? He must indeed be some man of impiety!"
trs.203: They said: "Who has done this to our âlihah (gods)? He must indeed be one of the Zâlimun (wrong-doers)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ

trs.20: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
trs.85: Some said, ‘We heard a youth called Abraham talking about them.’
trs.22: They said, "We heard a youth talk of them: He is called Abraham."
trs.203: They said: "We heard a young man talking against them, who is called Ibrâhîm (Abraham)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ

trs.20: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."<sup foot_note=196801>1</sup>
trs.85: They said, ‘Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial].’
trs.22: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness."
trs.203: They said: "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may testify."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ

trs.20: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
trs.85: They asked, ‘Was it you, Abraham, who did this to our gods?’
trs.22: They said, "Art thou the one that did this with our gods, O Abraham?"
trs.203: They said: "Are you the one who has done this to our gods, O Ibrâhîm (Abraham)?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ

trs.20: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
trs.85: He said, ‘No, it was done by the biggest of them- this one. Ask them, if they can talk.’
trs.22: He said: "Nay, this was done by - this is their biggest one! ask them, if they can speak intelligently!"
trs.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Nay, this one, the biggest of them (idols) did it. Ask them, if they can speak!"<sup foot_note=154724>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ

trs.20: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
trs.85: They turned to one another, saying, ‘It is you who are in the wrong,’
trs.22: So they turned to themselves and said, "Surely ye are the ones in the wrong!"
trs.203: So they turned to themselves and said: "Verily, you are the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ

trs.20: Then they reversed themselves,<sup foot_note=196802>1</sup> [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
trs.85: but then they lapsed again and said, ‘You know very well these gods cannot speak.’
trs.22: Then were they confounded with shame: (they said), "Thou knowest full well that these (idols) do not speak!"
trs.203: Then they turned to themselves (their first thought and said): "Indeed you [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] know well that these (idols) speak not!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ

trs.20: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
trs.85: Abraham said, ‘How can you worship what can neither benefit nor harm you, instead of God?
trs.22: (Abraham) said, "Do ye then worship, besides Allah, things that can neither be of any good to you nor do you harm?
trs.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Do you then worship besides Allâh, things that can neither profit you, nor harm you?

verses.text_uthmani: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ

trs.20: Uff<sup foot_note=196803>1</sup> to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
trs.85: Shame on you and on the things you worship instead of God. Have you no sense?’
trs.22: "Fie upon you, and upon the things that ye worship besides Allah! Have ye no sense?"..
trs.203: "Fie upon you, and upon that which you worship besides Allâh! Have you then no sense?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ

trs.20: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
trs.85: They said, ‘Burn him and avenge your gods, if you are going to do the right thing.’
trs.22: They said, "Burn him and protect your gods, If ye do (anything at all)!"
trs.203: They said: "Burn him and help your âlihah (gods), if you will be doing."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

trs.20: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
trs.85: But We said, ‘Fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.’
trs.22: We said, "O Fire! be thou cool, and (a means of) safety for Abraham!"
trs.203: We (Allâh) said: "O fire! Be you coolness and safety for Ibrâhîm (Abraham)!"

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ

trs.20: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.
trs.85: They planned to harm him, but We made them suffer the greatest loss.
trs.22: Then they sought a stratagem against him: but We made them the ones that lost most!
trs.203: And they wanted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
trs.85: We saved him and Lot [and sent them] to the land We blessed for all people,
trs.22: But We delivered him and (his nephew) Lut (and directed them) to the land which We have blessed for the nations.
trs.203: And We rescued him and Lût (Lot) to the land which We have blessed for the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn).

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ

trs.20: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
trs.85: and We gave him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and made each of them righteous.
trs.22: And We bestowed on him Isaac and, as an additional gift, (a grandson), Jacob, and We made righteous men of every one (of them).
trs.203: And We bestowed upon him Ishâq (Isaac), and (a grandson) Ya‘qûb (Jacob). Each one We made righteous.

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ

trs.20: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.
trs.85: We made all of them leaders, guiding others by Our command, and We inspired them to do good works, to keep up the prayer, and to give alms: they were Our true worshippers.
trs.22: And We made them leaders, guiding (men) by Our Command, and We sent them inspiration to do good deeds, to establish regular prayers, and to practise regular charity; and they constantly served Us (and Us only).
trs.203: And We made them leaders, guiding (mankind) by Our Command, and We revealed to them the doing of good deeds, performing Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât), and the giving of Zakât and of Us (Alone) they were the worshippers.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ

trs.20: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
trs.85: We gave Lot sound judgement and knowledge and saved him from the community who practised obscenities- they were shameless people who broke God’s law!
trs.22: And to Lut, too, We gave Judgment and Knowledge, and We saved him from the town which practised abominations: truly they were a people given to Evil, a rebellious people.
trs.203: And (remember) Lût (Lot), We gave him Hukm (right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) and (religious) knowledge, and We saved him from the town (folk) who practised Al-Khabâ’ith (evil, wicked and filthy deeds). Verily, they were a people given to evil, and were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

trs.20: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
trs.85: We admitted him to Our mercy; he was a righteous man.
trs.22: And We admitted him to Our Mercy: for he was one of the Righteous.
trs.203: And We admitted him to Our Mercy; truly, he was of the righteous.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

trs.20: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh]<sup foot_note=196804>1</sup> before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
trs.85: Long before that, We answered Noah when he cried out to Us: We saved him and his family from the great calamity
trs.22: (Remember) Noah, when he cried (to Us) aforetime: We listened to his (prayer) and delivered him and his family from great distress.
trs.203: And (remember) Nûh (Noah), when he cried (to Us) aforetime. We answered his invocation and saved him and his family from the great distress.

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
trs.85: and We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs- they were evil people, so We drowned them all.
trs.22: We helped him against people who rejected Our Signs: truly they were a people given to Evil: so We drowned them (in the Flood) all together.
trs.203: We helped him against the people who denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.). Verily, they were a people given to evil. So We drowned them all.

verses.text_uthmani: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ

trs.20: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night],<sup foot_note=196805>1</sup> and We were witness to their judgement.
trs.85: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgement regarding the field into which sheep strayed by night and grazed. We witnessed their judgement
trs.22: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the matter of the field into which the sheep of certain people had strayed by night: We did witness their judgment.
trs.203: And (remember) Dâwûd (David) and Sulaimân (Solomon), when they gave judgement in the case of the field in which the sheep of certain people had pastured at night; and We were witness to their judgement.

verses.text_uthmani: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ

trs.20: And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].<sup foot_note=196806>1</sup>
trs.85: and made Solomon understand the case [better], though We gave sound judgement and knowledge to both of them. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate Our praises with David- We did all these things-
trs.22: To Solomon We inspired the (right) understanding of the matter: to each (of them) We gave Judgment and Knowledge; it was Our power that made the hills and the birds celebrate Our praises, with David: it was We Who did (all these things).
trs.203: And We made Sulaimân (Solomon) to understand (the case); and to each of them We gave Hukm (right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains and the birds to glorify Our Praises along with Dâwûd (David). And it was We Who were the doer (of all these things).

translation.text: And We gave understanding of it

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ

trs.20: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
trs.85: We taught him how to make coats of mail for the benefit of you [people], to protect you in your wars, but are you grateful for this?
trs.22: It was We Who taught him the making of coats of mail for your benefit, to guard you from each other's violence: will ye then be grateful?
trs.203: And We taught him the making of metal coats of mail (for battles), to protect you in your fighting. Are you then grateful?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
trs.85: We harnessed the stormy wind for Solomon, so that it sped by his command to the land We had blessed- We have knowledge of all things-
trs.22: (It was Our power that made) the violent (unruly) wind flow (tamely) for Solomon, to his order, to the land which We had blessed: for We do know all things.
trs.203: And to Sulaimân (Solomon) (We subjected) the wind strongly raging, running by his command towards the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are the All-Knower.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ

trs.20: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.<sup foot_note=196807>1</sup>
trs.85: and We made some of the jinn subservient to him, to dive for him and do other works besides. We were watching over them.
trs.22: And of the evil ones, were some who dived for him, and did other work besides; and it was We Who guarded them.
trs.203: And of the Shayâtîn (devils from the jinn) were some who dived for him, and did other work besides that; and it was We Who guarded them.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ

trs.20: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."
trs.85: Remember Job, when he cried to his Lord, ‘Suffering has truly afflicted me, but you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.’
trs.22: And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, "Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."
trs.203: And (remember) Ayyûb (Job), when he cried to his Lord: "Verily, distress has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy."

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ

trs.20: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].
trs.85: We answered him, removed his suffering, and restored his family to him, along with more like them, as an act of grace from Us and a reminder for all who serve Us.
trs.22: So We listened to him: We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his people to him, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who serve Us.
trs.203: So We answered his call, and We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his family to him (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them as a mercy from Ourselves and a Reminder for all those who worship Us.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ

trs.20: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
trs.85: And remember Ishmael, Idris, and Dhu’l-Kifl: they were all steadfast.
trs.22: And (remember) Isma'il, Idris, and Zul-kifl, all (men) of constancy and patience;
trs.203: And (remember) Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael), and Idrîs (Enoch) and Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah): all were from among As-Sâbirûn (the patient).

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

trs.20: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
trs.85: We admitted them to Our mercy; they were truly righteous.
trs.22: We admitted them to Our mercy: for they were of the righteous ones.
trs.203: And We admitted them to Our Mercy. Verily, they were of the righteous.

verses.text_uthmani: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger<sup foot_note=196810>1</sup> and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him.<sup foot_note=196809>2</sup> And he called out within the darknesses,<sup foot_note=196808>3</sup> "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
trs.85: And remember the man with the whale,when he went off angrily, thinking We could not restrict him, but then he cried out in the deep darkness, ‘There is no God but You, glory be to You, I was wrong.’
trs.22: And remember Zun-nun, when he departed in wrath: He imagined that We had no power over him! But he cried through the deptHs of darkness, "There is no god but thou: glory to thee: I was indeed wrong!"
trs.203: And (remember) Dhun-Nûn (Jonah), when he went off in anger, and imagined that We shall not punish him (i.e. the calamities which had befallen him)! But he cried through the darkness (saying): Lâ ilâha illâ Anta [none has the right to be worshipped but You (O, Allâh)], Glorified (and Exalted) be You [above all that (evil) they associate with You]! Truly, I have been of the wrong-doers."

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

trs.20: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
trs.85: We answered him and saved him from distress: this is how We save the faithful.
trs.22: So We listened to him: and delivered him from distress: and thus do We deliver those who have faith.
trs.203: So We answered his call, and delivered him from the distress. And thus We do deliver the believers (who believe in the Oneness of Allâh, abstain from evil and work righteousness).

verses.text_uthmani: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ

trs.20: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
trs.85: Remember Zachariah, when he cried to his Lord, ‘My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of heirs.’
trs.22: And (remember) Zakariya, when he cried to his Lord: "O my Lord! leave me not without offspring, though thou art the best of inheritors."
trs.203: And (remember) Zakariyyâ (Zachariah), when he cried to his Lord: "O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors."

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ

trs.20: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate<sup foot_note=196811>1</sup> Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
trs.85: We answered him––We gave him John, and cured his wife of barrenness- they were always keen to do good deeds. They called upon Us out of longing and awe, and humbled themselves before Us.
trs.22: So We listened to him: and We granted him Yahya: We cured his wife's (Barrenness) for him. These (three) were ever quick in emulation in good works; they used to call on Us with love and reverence, and humble themselves before Us.
trs.203: So We answered his call, and We bestowed upon him Yahyâ (John), and cured his wife (to bear a child) for him. Verily, they used to hasten on to do good deeds, and they used to call on Us with hope and fear, and used to humble themselves before Us.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهَا مِن رُّوحِنَا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا وَٱبْنَهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
trs.85: Remember the one who guarded her chastity. We breathed into her from Our Spirit and made her and her son a sign for all people.
trs.22: And (remember) her who guarded her chastity: We breathed into her of Our spirit, and We made her and her son a sign for all peoples.
trs.203: And she who guarded her chastity [Virgin Maryam (Mary)]: We breathed into (the sleeves of) her (shirt or garment) [through Our Rûh - Jibrîl (Gabriel)],<sup foot_note=154725>1</sup> and We made her and her son [‘Îsâ (Jesus)] a sign for Al-‘Âlamîn (the mankind and jinn).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ

trs.20: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion,<sup foot_note=196812>1</sup> and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
trs.85: [Messengers], this community of yours is one single community and I am your Lord, so serve Me.
trs.22: Verily, this brotherhood of yours is a single brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore serve Me (and no other).
trs.203: Truly! This, your Ummah [Shari‘ah or religion (Islâmic Monotheism)] is one religion, and I am your Lord, therefore worship Me (Alone). [Tafsîr Ibn Kathîr]

verses.text_uthmani: وَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلٌّ إِلَيْنَا رَٰجِعُونَ

trs.20: And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves,<sup foot_note=196813>1</sup> [but] all to Us will return.
trs.85: They have torn their unity apart, but they will all return to Us.
trs.22: But (later generations) cut off their affair (of unity), one from another: (yet) will they all return to Us.
trs.203: But they have broken up and differed as regards their religion among themselves. (And) they all shall return to Us.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا كُفْرَانَ لِسَعْيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَـٰتِبُونَ

trs.20: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort,<sup foot_note=196814>1</sup> and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.
trs.85: If anyone does good deeds and is a believer, his efforts will not be ignored: We record them for him.
trs.22: Whoever works any act of righteousness and has faith,- His endeavour will not be rejected: We shall record it in his favour.
trs.203: So whoever does righteous good deeds while he is a believer (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism), his efforts will not be rejected. Verily We record it for him (in his Book of deeds).<sup foot_note=154726>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: وَحَرَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ

trs.20: And it is prohibited to [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return<sup foot_note=196815>1</sup>
trs.85: No community destroyed by Us can escape its return,
trs.22: But there is a ban on any population which We have destroyed: that they shall not return,
trs.203: And a ban is laid on every town (population) which We have destroyed that they shall not return (to this world again, nor repent to Us).

verses.text_uthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فُتِحَتْ يَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَهُم مِّن كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنسِلُونَ

trs.20: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
trs.85: and when the peoples of Gog and Magog are let loose and swarm swiftly from every highland,
trs.22: Until the Gog and Magog (people) are let through (their barrier), and they swiftly swarm from every hill.
trs.203: Until, when Ya’jûj and Ma’jûj (Gog and Magog)<sup foot_note=154727>1</sup> are let loose (from their barrier), and they swoop down from every mound.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱقْتَرَبَ ٱلْوَعْدُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَإِذَا هِىَ شَـٰخِصَةٌ أَبْصَـٰرُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا قَدْ كُنَّا فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا بَلْ كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ

trs.20: And [when] the true promise [i.e., the resurrection] has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
trs.85: when the True Promise draws near, the disbelievers’ eyes will stare in terror, and they will say, ‘Woe to us! We were not aware of this at all. We were wrong.’
trs.22: Then will the true promise draw nigh (of fulfilment): then behold! the eyes of the Unbelievers will fixedly stare in horror: "Ah! Woe to us! we were indeed heedless of this; nay, we truly did wrong!"
trs.203: And the true promise (Day of Resurrection) shall draw near (of fulfillment). Then (when mankind is resurrected from their graves), you shall see the eyes of the disbelievers fixedly staring in horror. (They will say): "Woe to us! We were indeed heedless of this - nay, but we were Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ حَصَبُ جَهَنَّمَ أَنتُمْ لَهَا وَٰرِدُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allāh are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
trs.85: You [disbelievers] and what you worship instead of God will be fuel for Hell: that is where you will go-
trs.22: Verily ye, (unbelievers), and the (false) gods that ye worship besides Allah, are (but) fuel for Hell! to it will ye (surely) come!
trs.203: Certainly you (disbelievers) and that which you are worshipping now besides Allâh, are (but) fuel for Hell! (Surely), you will enter it.<sup foot_note=154728>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: لَوْ كَانَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ءَالِهَةً مَّا وَرَدُوهَا ۖ وَكُلٌّ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ

trs.20: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
trs.85: if these [idols] had been real gods they would not have gone there- you will all stay there.
trs.22: If these had been gods, they would not have got there! but each one will abide therein.
trs.203: Had these (idols) been âlihah (gods), they would not have entered there (Hell), and all of them will abide therein.

verses.text_uthmani: لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌ وَهُمْ فِيهَا لَا يَسْمَعُونَ

trs.20: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
trs.85: There the disbelievers will be groaning piteously, but the [idols] will hear nothing.
trs.22: There, sobbing will be their lot, nor will they there hear (aught else).
trs.203: Therein they will be breathing out with deep sighs and roaring and therein they will hear not.<sup foot_note=154729>1</sup>

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ سَبَقَتْ لَهُم مِّنَّا ٱلْحُسْنَىٰٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عَنْهَا مُبْعَدُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
trs.85: But those for whom We have decreed Paradise will be kept far from Hell-
trs.22: Those for whom the good (record) from Us has gone before, will be removed far therefrom.
trs.203: Verily, those for whom the good has preceded from Us, they will be removed far therefrom (Hell) [e.g. ‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary); ‘Uzair (Ezra)].

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ حَسِيسَهَا ۖ وَهُمْ فِى مَا ٱشْتَهَتْ أَنفُسُهُمْ خَـٰلِدُونَ

trs.20: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
trs.85: they will not hear a murmur from it- and endlessly they will enjoy everything their souls desire.
trs.22: Not the slightest sound will they hear of Hell: what their souls desired, in that will they dwell.
trs.203: They shall not hear the slightest sound of it (Hell), while they abide in that which their ownselves desire.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَحْزُنُهُمُ ٱلْفَزَعُ ٱلْأَكْبَرُ وَتَتَلَقَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ هَـٰذَا يَوْمُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror,<sup foot_note=196816>1</sup> and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
trs.85: They will have no fear of the great Terror: the angels will receive them with the words, ‘This is the Day you were promised!’
trs.22: The Great Terror will bring them no grief: but the angels will meet them (with mutual greetings): "This is your Day,- (the Day) that ye were promised."
trs.203: The greatest terror (on the Day of Resurrection) will not grieve them, and the angels will meet them, (with the greeting): "This is your Day which you were promised."

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَطْوِى ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَىِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلْكُتُبِ ۚ كَمَا بَدَأْنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُّعِيدُهُۥ ۚ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ

trs.20: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.<sup foot_note=196817>1</sup>
trs.85: On that Day, We shall roll up the skies as a writer rolls up [his] scrolls. We shall reproduce creation just as We produced it the first time: this is Our binding promise. We shall certainly do all these things.
trs.22: The Day that We roll up the heavens like a scroll rolled up for books (completed),- even as We produced the first creation, so shall We produce a new one: a promise We have undertaken: truly shall We fulfil it.
trs.203: And (remember) the Day when We shall roll up the heaven like a scroll rolled up for books. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise binding upon Us. Truly, We shall do it.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَتَبْنَا فِى ٱلزَّبُورِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلذِّكْرِ أَنَّ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَرِثُهَا عِبَادِىَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ

trs.20: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms]<sup foot_note=196819>1</sup> after the [previous] mention<sup foot_note=196818>2</sup> that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
trs.85: We wrote in the Psalms, as We did in [earlier] Scripture: ‘My righteous servants will inherit the earth.’
trs.22: Before this We wrote in the Psalms, after the Message (given to Moses): My servants the righteous, shall inherit the earth."
trs.203: And indeed We have written in Az-Zabûr [i.e. all the revealed Holy Books - the Taurât (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel), the Psalms, the Qur’ân,] after (We have already written in) Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz (the Book that is in the heaven with Allâh), that My righteous slaves shall inherit the land (i.e. the land of Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ فِى هَـٰذَا لَبَلَـٰغًا لِّقَوْمٍ عَـٰبِدِينَ

trs.20: Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is notification for a worshipping people.
trs.85: There truly is a message in this for the servants of God!
trs.22: Verily in this (Qur'an) is a Message for people who would (truly) worship Allah.
trs.203: Verily, in this (the Qur’ân) there is a plain Message for people who worship Allâh (i.e. the true, real believers of Islâmic Monotheism who act practically on the Qur’ân and the Sunnah - legal ways of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم).

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
trs.85: It was only as a mercy that We sent you [Prophet] to all people.
trs.22: We sent thee not, but as a Mercy for all creatures.
trs.203: And We have sent you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): not but as a mercy for the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ

trs.20: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
trs.85: Say, ‘What is revealed to me is that your God is one God- will you submit to Him?’
trs.22: Say: "What has come to me by inspiration is that your Allah is One Allah: will ye therefore bow to His Will (in Islam)?"
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "It is revealed to me that your Ilâh (God) is only one Ilâh (God - Allâh). Will you then submit to His Will (become Muslims and stop worshipping others besides Allâh)?"

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُلْ ءَاذَنتُكُمْ عَلَىٰ سَوَآءٍ ۖ وَإِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ أَم بَعِيدٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ

trs.20: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally.<sup foot_note=196820>1</sup> And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
trs.85: But if they turn away, say, ‘I have proclaimed the message fairly to you all. I do not know whether the judgement you are promised is near or far,
trs.22: But if they turn back, Say: "I have proclaimed the Message to you all alike and in truth; but I know not whether that which ye are promised is near or far.
trs.203: But if they (disbelievers, idolaters, Jews, Christians, polytheists) turn away (from Islâmic Monotheism) say (to them O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I give you a notice (of war as) to be known to us all alike. And I know not whether that which you are promised (i.e. the torment or the Day of Resurrection) is near or far.<sup foot_note=154730>1</sup>"

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَكْتُمُونَ

trs.20: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
trs.85: but He knows what you reveal and conceal.
trs.22: "It is He Who knows what is open in speech and what ye hide (in your hearts).
trs.203: (Say O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): Verily, He (Allâh) knows that which is spoken aloud (openly) and that which you conceal.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنْ أَدْرِى لَعَلَّهُۥ فِتْنَةٌ لَّكُمْ وَمَتَـٰعٌ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ

trs.20: And I know not; perhaps it<sup foot_note=196821>1</sup> is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
trs.85: I do not know: this [time] may well be a test for you, and enjoyment for a while.’
trs.22: "I know not but that it may be a trial for you, and a grant of (worldly) livelihood (to you) for a time."
trs.203: And I know not, perhaps it may be a trial for you, and an enjoyment for a while.

verses.text_uthmani: قَـٰلَ رَبِّ ٱحْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَرَبُّنَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ

trs.20: [The Prophet (ﷺ)] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."<sup foot_note=196822>1</sup>
trs.85: He said,‘My Lord, pass the true judgement.’ And, ‘Our Lord is the Lord of Mercy. We seek His assistance against what you [disbelievers] say.’
trs.22: Say: "O my Lord! judge Thou in truth!" "Our Lord Most Gracious is the One Whose assistance should be sought against the blasphemies ye utter!"
trs.203: He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: "My Lord! Judge You in truth! Our Lord is the Most Gracious, Whose Help is to be sought against that which you attribute (unto Allâh that He has offspring, and unto Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم that he is a sorcerer, and unto the Qur’ân that it is poetry)!"

translation.text: the One Whose help is sought
